claims.text: Is INDIA Near the Top for Coal Rents?
claims.support: India value is 1.28%, rank 5 out of 191.

claims.text: Comparing national economic reliance on coal rents as a share of GDP across major global economies using World Bank data.
claims.support: Indicator NY.GDP.COAL.RT.ZS from World Bank measures coal rents as a share of GDP.

claims.text: Coal rents make up 1.3% of GDP in India. In the USA, it is just 0.2%.
That puts India near the top among major economies for coal earnings relative to its economy.
claims.support: India rank is 5 in the dataset.

claims.text: It counts the profit margin between world market prices for coal and total production costs.
claims.support: Definition: Coal rents are the difference between the value of both hard and soft coal production at world prices and their total costs of production.

claims.text: Mongolia hits even higher, where coal rents generate 4.9% of GDP.
Mozambique follows at 3.8%, South Africa at 2.4%, and India sits at 1.3%.
Meanwhile, Germany stands at 0.01%, and the UK drops to 0.001%.
How much does coal power the economy in your country?
